description: This file declares types, external variables, and functions related to event handling in a WLD (Wireless Local Device) system, including callback management and event queue definitions.

methods.name: wld_event_add_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback to a specified event queue.

methods.name: wld_event_remove_callback
methods.description: Removes a callback from a specified event queue.

methods.name: wld_event_trigger_callback
methods.description: Triggers all callbacks registered to a specified event queue with provided data.

methods.name: wld_event_destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the event handling system.
